attacks.name: Reverse Polarity
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

If the defender is within |!range| 2 of this character during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may reroll any number of its attack dice; if it is not, after the attack is resolved, Push the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Magnetic Crush
steps: When creating the dice pool for this attack, this character destroys all interactive terrain features of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 of the defender. Choose up to 1 terrain feature destroyed in this way. Add dice to the attack roll equal to the |!size| of the chosen terrain feature. Add an additional die to the attack roll for each other terrain feature destroyed in this way.
Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: From the Ruins . . . (Affiliation: Brotherhood of Mutants)
superPowers.body: When a terrain feature is destroyed, after the effect is resolved, choose a number of allied characters equal to or less than the terrain feature's |!size|. Each chosen character gains 1 |!power|. A character may gain only 1 |!power| as a result of this Leadership ability per Turn.

superPowers.name: Fatal Attraction
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_large|. Before using this superpower, this character must pay 1 |!power| for each time it has already been used this Turn.

superPowers.name: Polarity Shielding
superPowers.body: When this character would be Advanced, Pushed, or Thrown, it may use this superpower. This character is not Advanced, Pushed, or Thrown.

superPowers.name: Master of Magnetism
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, if there are fewer than 2 allied |*Metal Construct| terrain features in play, Place 1 allied |*Metal Construct| terrain feature within |!range| 3 of this character. It is a |!size| 2 interactive terrain feature. Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 |!power| for each allied |*Metal Construct| in play.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
"Shrapnel Blast" replaced by "Magnetic Crush". Shrapnel Blast was a |!range| 2 area attack that could be measured from an allied Metal Construct within |!range| 3 and inflicted a guaranteed Stun.

"Fatal Attraction" reworked: fixed Power Cost of 2 instead of spending 1 to 4 |!power|. The chosen terrain feature must now be Size 4 or less instead of being dependent on the number of |!power| spent.

"Force Projection" replaced by "Polarity Shielding". Force Projection allowed this character to use its |!mystic| Defense against attacks and for dodge rolls, and prevented this character from being Pushed or Thrown by the attack or collision effects.
